name: Claude Code and Codex over ACP
description: claude-acp and codex-acp: the same two CLIs driven through the Agent Client Protocol instead of tmux. The board shows the session as a read-only event log; the 👁 drawer opens it in a terminal or the desktop app instead. Each CLI logs in with its own login (`claude`, `codex login`). Versions are pinned: both adapters release daily, and a new one can break the session protocol.

profiles.name: claude-acp
profiles.installHint: needs node (npx) and a Claude Code login: run `claude` once

profiles.name: codex-acp
profiles.installHint: needs node (npx) and a Codex login: run `codex login`
